positive.prompt: Bikin PRD untuk sistem baru sebelum kita mulai coding
Get prd for the app I want to build
Grill me about what I want and turn it into a PRD
Mau develop sistem baru, bantu susun requirement documentnya dulu

negative.prompt: Write a spec for the API contract only
Ask me one question at a time about my preference, no document needed
Run the full test suite and report failures

evals.prompt: I want to build an inventory management system for my small shop. Get prd.
evals.expected_output: A multi-round design-tree interview with confidence tracking, a gap check against the nine PRD areas, and an approved PRD
expectations: A hypothesis with a confidence number is stated before the first question
Questions are asked in rounds, each numbered with a recommendation attached
The agent does not move to PRD authoring before the user confirms a restate of intent
The PRD template is filled or explicitly marked Not applicable section by section
An explicit yes is requested before the PRD is saved
